title: Documentation ownership
summary: Public product guidance is authored under docs/public and derived into installed .yoke/docs and the packaged corpus; web delivery consumes the exact candidate. Project policy, live facts and private operations retain their own owners. docs/teaching is source-contributor material and never installs. Global hook orientation, user-level yoke-global appearance and actual global receiving proof remain owned by YOK-3975; their absence is not delivery success.
